research_findings: Discovered missing transaction isolation levels in critical Prisma transactions within src/lib/launch-offer-grant.ts and src/app/actions/progress/sessions.ts which handle limits and counting.

Identified that launch-offer-grant.ts counts available slots before inserting claims. Without Serializable isolation level, concurrent requests could result in race conditions exceeding LAUNCH_PLATFORM_SLOTS.

Identified that sessions.ts initiates practice sessions and attempts counting inside a transaction. Lack of Serializable isolation could allow concurrent creation of duplicate sessions, inflating attempt counts.
Identified unhandled rate limiting TODO in src/app/actions/waitlist.ts.
features_improved: Enhanced database transaction integrity by enforcing strict Serializable isolation for launch offer redemptions, preventing race conditions that could bypass slot limits.
Enforced Serializable isolation on practice session starts to prevent duplicate session creation.
Added rate limiting to the waitlist action via in-memory map based on user IPs.
Removed the word 'Hack' from the frontend UI string in AuditLogVisualizer.tsx.
next_steps_for_next_run: Continue reviewing and optimizing database queries for other high-traffic endpoints.
Implement persistent rate limiting (e.g. Redis) instead of the simple in-memory implementation for production environments.
